verdict.rationale: Maritime is described as a cloud platform for deploying and hosting agents. Self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product, but nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the platform itself. Bring-your-own Docker images and migrating workloads onto Maritime both run on Maritime's own cloud, so they are not self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
